bundle.shortDescription: AI-assisted Remotion studio for microstock creators.
bundle.longDescription: Remotion Studio Tools Microstock is a Windows desktop app that pairs a multi-provider AI assistant (OpenAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with a Remotion-powered video studio that renders 4K UHD footage at 30fps by default, tailored for microstock creators.
